weaknesses: Task quotas burn on multi-step Zaps
bestFor: Ops teams that need the widest SaaS connector catalogue with AI steps

No-code AI agent studios as the primary job (MindStudio) — landscape only
tradeoffs: Published free tiers vs paid usage/credit caps
Bundled Workspace/One plans vs standalone assistant pricing

recommendation: Choose Zapier when no-code app automation with AI steps is the job — not ChatGPT as an LLM, and not MindStudio as an agent studio by default. Compare n8n for self-host / execution-volume automation; MindStudio only on landscape pages if the job is building AI agents.
